faq_a1: All trip earnings go to your in-app wallet. You can withdraw to Orange Money, MyZaka, Smega, or your bank anytime.
faq_a2: Cash trips debit your commission (18%) from your wallet. Top up to clear the debt and keep receiving cash trips.
faq_a3: Complete your first trip (P50 bonus), hit 50 trips in a week (P250 bonus), or refer another driver (P100 bonus after they complete 5 trips).
faq_a4: You may be eligible for a cancellation fee. Keep the app open — our system tracks who cancelled and why.
faq_q5: How do I change my vehicle?
faq_a5: Go to Vehicle from the home screen. If you need to register a new car, contact support.

faq_rider_q1: How do I book a ride?
faq_rider_a1: Open the Home tab, set your pickup and destination, choose a service, and tap Book. You'll be matched with a nearby driver within seconds.
faq_rider_a2: Yes. Most trips are cash-based. Pay the driver directly at the end of the trip.
faq_rider_q3: How do I cancel a trip?
faq_rider_a3: Open the active trip screen and tap Cancel. Free while we're finding a driver; a small fee may apply after the driver accepts.
faq_rider_a4: Every uMuv driver is verified through strict KYC — license, Omang/Passport, vehicle registration, and more.
